origin.description: Whether each string contains SGR, CSI, or hyperlink sequences.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

origin.details: Detects SGR, other CSI, and OSC 8 hyperlinks.
origin.value: True or False for each string. None stays missing.
